newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian repair docks boosts capital, splits stock.
newsitem.headline: Croatian repair docks boosts capital, splits stock.

text.p: The Rijeka-based repair docks Viktor Lenac said on Friday it had increased its capital to 106.2 million kuna and split its stock ahead of its first listing on Croatia's central bourse.
The share price was rounded up to 400 kuna after being converted from the 100 German mark face value, a secretary of the board told Reuters by telephone.
The new nominal share price is 100 kuna.
Some 1.06 million ordinary shares in Viktor Lenac will start trading from July 15 as the fifth fully-listed stock on the exchange.
